description: Header file defining the ResolvedTargetData class used for computing and caching target dependency information in a build system, including methods for retrieving dependencies, libraries, frameworks, and related data for build targets.

classes.name: ResolvedTargetData
classes.description: Class for computing and caching target dependency data, including methods to retrieve dependencies, libraries, frameworks, and other target-related information.

methods.name: GetTargetDeps
methods.description: Returns the dependencies of a target as a ResolvedTargetDeps instance.

methods.name: GetDataDeps
methods.description: Returns data dependencies of a target.

methods.name: GetLinkedDeps
methods.description: Returns linked dependencies of a target.

methods.name: GetLinkedLibraryDirs
methods.description: Returns library directory search paths for a target.

methods.name: GetLinkedLibraries
methods.description: Returns library files for linking a target.

methods.name: GetLinkedFrameworkDirs
methods.description: Returns framework directory search paths for macOS/iOS binaries.

methods.name: GetLinkedWeakFrameworks
methods.description: Returns weak framework names for linking.

methods.name: GetLinkedWeakLibraries
methods.description: Returns weak library files for linking.

methods.name: GetHardDeps
methods.description: Returns hard dependencies of a target.
